40002370.author: पदार्थः
40002370.content: अथ thereafter, पौरेषु citizens, गतेषु सत्सु had departed, निश्चयज्ञः knows how to take decisions, प्रभुः Lord, नृपः king, मन्त्रिभि: सह together with counsellors, भूयः again, मन्त्रयित्वा having consulted, श्वः एव tomorrow itself, पुष्यः Pushya star, भविता is in the ascendance, राजीवताम्राक्षः a man whose eyes resemble red lotus (petals), मे सुतः my son, रामः Rama, श्वः tomorrow, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेच्यः should be  installed, इति thus, निश्चयम् decision, चक्रे made.

40002370.author: Translation
40002370.content: After the citizens departed, the king, an expert in decisionmaking again consulted his counsellors and said, Tomorrow Pushya star is in the ascendence and my son, Rama (handsome) with coppercoloured eyes which resemble red lotus petals will be installed heirapparent.

40002371.author: पदार्थः
40002371.content: अथ thereafter, पौरेषु citizens, गतेषु सत्सु had departed, निश्चयज्ञः knows how to take decisions, प्रभुः Lord, नृपः king, मन्त्रिभि: सह together with counsellors, भूयः again, मन्त्रयित्वा having consulted, श्वः एव tomorrow itself, पुष्यः Pushya star, भविता is in the ascendance, राजीवताम्राक्षः a man whose eyes resemble red lotus (petals), मे सुतः my son, रामः Rama, श्वः tomorrow, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेच्यः should be  installed, इति thus, निश्चयम् decision, चक्रे made.

40002371.author: Translation
40002371.content: After the citizens departed, the king, an expert in decisionmaking again consulted his counsellors and said, Tomorrow Pushya star is in the ascendence and my son, Rama (handsome) with coppercoloured eyes which resemble red lotus petals will be installed heirapparent.

40002372.author: पदार्थः
40002372.content: अथ thereafter, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, अन्तर्गृहम् inner apartment, आविश्य having entered, तदा then, रामम् Rama, पुनः again, इह here, आनय bring him, सूतम् charioteer  Sumantra, आमन्त्रयामास ordered.

40002372.author: Translation
40002372.content: Therafter king Dasaratha on retiring to his private apartment, ordered Sumantra to bring Rama  once again.

40002373.author: पदार्थः
40002373.content: सः सूतः the charioteer, तत् वाक्यम् that order, प्रतिगृह्य having received, पुनः again, रामम् Rama, आनयितुम् to fetch, शीघ्रम् speedily, रामस्य Rama's, भवनम् palace, उपाययौ  reached.

40002373.author: Translation
40002373.content: In obedience to the command  of the king charioteer Sumantra set out speedily  to the palace of Rama to fetch him  back once again.

40002374.author: पदार्थः
40002374.content: पुनः again, तस्य his, आगमनम् arrival, द्वाः स्धैः by doorkeepers, रामाय to Rama, आवेदितम् was reported, तम् him, प्राप्तम् had arrived, श्रुत्वा एव on listening, रामः Rama, शङ्कान्वितः अभवत् was filled with apprehensions.

40002374.author: Translation
40002374.content: The doorkeepers informed Rama of Sumantra's arrival. As soon as he learnt that Sumantra was back again, Rama was filled with apprehensions.

40002375.author: पदार्थः
40002375.content: रामः Rama, एनम् him, त्वरितम् quickly  प्रवेश्य having admitted , वचनम् words अब्रवीत् said, भूयः again, ते your, आगमनकृत्यम् purpose of coming back, यत् whatever is there  तत्  that one, अशेषतः completely, ब्रूहि  tell

40002375.author: Translation
40002375.content: Rama  got Sumantra admitted  and said to him, What is the  purpose of your coming back so quickly ? Tell me whatever is there without holding back.

40002376.author: पदार्थः
40002376.content: ततः thereafter, सूतः charioteer, तम् addressing him, उवाच spoke, राजा king, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छति  desires, श्रुत्वा having heard, अत्र in this matter, गमनाय either to go, इतराय वा or otherwise, त्वम् you alone, प्रमाणम् are the authority.

40002376.author: Translation
40002376.content: Then Sumantra replied, 'The king desires to see you. To go or not to go, the decision is yours'.

40002377.author: पदार्थः
40002377.content: इति thus, सूतवचः words of the charioteer, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, अथ afterwards, त्वरया with haste, अन्वितः seized, नरेश्वरम् king, पुनः again, द्रष्टुम् to see, राजभवनम् to royal palace, प्रययौ departed.

40002377.author: Translation
40002377.content: On hearing the words of the charioteer, Rama immediately set out for the royal  palace to see the king again.

40002378.author: पदार्थः
40002378.content: दशरथः नृपः king Dasaratha, तम् रामम् that Rama, समनुप्राप्तम् of his arrival, श्रुत्वा having heard, उत्तमम् exceedingly, प्रियम् pleasing, विवक्षुः to tell, गृहम् palace, प्रवेशयामास got him admitted.

40002378.author: Translation
40002378.content: Having heard of Rama's arrival, king Dasaratha got him admitted into his apartment to tell him something very pleasant.

40002379.author: पदार्थः
40002379.content: श्रीमान् glorious, राघवः Rama, पितुः father's, भवनम् palace, प्रविशन्नेव while entering, कृताञ्जलिः folded hands, दूरात् from a distance, पितरम् to his father, प्रणिपत्य bending low in reverence, ददर्श beheld.

40002379.author: Translation
40002379.content: On entering his father's palace, glorious Rama, folded his hands and bent low in reverence from a distance and beheld his father.

40002380.author: पदार्थः
40002380.content: भूमिपः protector of the earth (king Dasaratha), प्रणमन्तम् as he (Rama) was bending low, तम् him, समुत्थाप्य lifted up, परिष्वज्य embracing, अस्मै him, रुचिरम् splendid, आसनम् seat, प्रदिश्य च having offered, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said.

40002380.author: Translation
40002380.content: As he (Rama) was bending (with reverence), Dasaratha lifted him up and embraced him. Thereafter, he offered him a splendid seat and said again:

40002381.author: पदार्थः
40002381.content: राम O Rama, दीर्घायुः one with long life, वृद्धः अस्मि I have become old, मया by me, ईप्सिताः desires, भोगाः pleasures, भुक्ताः enjoyed, अन्नवद्भिः cooked rice, भूरिदक्षिणैः abundance of donations, क्रतुशतैः by hundreds of rituals, इष्टम् is performed.

40002381.author: Translation
40002381.content: O Rama after a long life I have grown old. I have enjoyed all the pleasures I desired. I have also performed hundreds of rituals which enjoined distribution of abundant food and gifts.

40002382.author: पदार्थः
40002382.content: पुरूषसत्तम the very best of men( Rama), त्वम् you, अद्य now, भुवि on this earth, अनुपमम्  incomparable, इष्टम् to my liking, अपत्यम् as progeny, मे to me, जातम् was born, मया by me, दत्तम् given (performed), इष्टम् rituals (prescribed for kshatriyas), अधीतं च studied (Vedas) also.

40002382.author: Translation
40002382.content: O best of men I have obtained now a progeny of my liking in you and you have no equal on earth. I have given gifts, performed rituals and also studied (the Vedas) .

40002383.author: पदार्थः
40002383.content: वीर O mighty one, मया by me, इष्टानि my favouite ones, सुखान्यपि pleasures, अनुभूतानि were experienced, देवर्षिपितृविप्राणाम् with regard to my obligations to gods, sages, my ancestors and brahmins, तथा and also, आत्मनः for me, अनृणः अस्मि I am freed from debt.

40002383.author: Translation
40002383.content: O mighty son I have experienced all the pleasures I longed for. I redeemed my debt to the gods, the sages, my ancestors, brahmins and to myself.

40002384.author: पदार्थः
40002384.content: तव your, अभिषेचनात् अन्यत्र other than consecration, कर्तव्यम् duty, न किञ्चित् nothing, मम my, अतः for that reason, अहम् I, त्वाम् to you, यत् whatever, ब्रूयाम् I shall tell you, तत् that one, त्वम् you, मे to me, कर्तुम् to perform, अर्हसि it behoves you.

40002384.author: Translation
40002384.content: There is nothing left to be done by me except your consecration Hence you should perform what I  tell you.

40002385.author: पदार्थः
40002385.content: अद्य today, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः the subjects, त्वाम् you, नराधिपम् as king, इच्छन्ति wish, पुत्रक my dear son, अतः so, त्वाम् you, युवराजानम् as heirapparent, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I am going to install.

40002385.author: Translation
40002385.content: Today  all the subjects expresed their desire to see you as their king. Therefore, my dear son, I wish to coronate  you heirapparent.

40002386.author: पदार्थः
40002386.content: राम O Rama, अपि च also, अद्य now, स्वप्ने in a dream, दारुणान् frightening, अशुभान् inauspicious events, पश्यामि am seeing, दिवा during day time, सनिर्घाता accompanied by thunders, महास्वना generating great sounds, उल्का meteor, इह here, पतति is falling.

40002386.author: Translation
40002386.content: Moreover Rama, these days I see frightening and ominous events in dreams during day time. I see meteors accompanied by thunders falling, generating great sounds.

40002387.author: पदार्थः
40002387.content: राम O Rama, सूर्याङ्गारकराहुभिः Sun, Mars and Rahu, दारुणैः formidable, ग्रहैः planets, मे my, नक्षत्रम् birth star, अवष्टब्धम् have afflicted, दैवज्ञाः astrologers, आवेदयन्ति are communicating.

40002387.author: Translation
40002387.content: O Rama astrologers also tell me that formidable planets Sun, Mars and Rahu have afflicted my birth star.

40002388.author: पदार्थः
40002388.content: ईदृशानाम् when such, निमित्तानाम् of ominous signs, समुद्भवे appear, प्रायेण हि usually, राजा king, मृत्युम् death, आप्नोति meets, घोराम् grave, आपदं वा or calamity, ऋच्छति  faces.

40002388.author: Translation
40002388.content: When such ominous signs appear, usually the king either meets with  death or faces a grave calamity.

40002389.author: पदार्थः
40002389.content: तत् so, राघव son of the Raghus (Rama), मे my, चेतः mind, यावदेव so long as, न विमु३ह्यति is not  deluded, तावदेव till then, अभिषिञ्चस्व be consecrated, प्राणिनाम् men's, मतिः mind, चला हि is unstable indeed.

40002389.author: Translation
40002389.content: Therefore,  before my mind is deluded I wish to see you installed as heirapparent for a man's mind is unstable indeed, O Rama.

40002390.author: पदार्थः
40002390.content: अद्य today, चन्द्रः Moon, पुष्यात् than star Pushya, पूर्वम् preceding, पुनर्वसू constellation Punarvasu, अभ्युपगतः entered, श्वः tomorrow, पुष्ययोगम् in conjuction with  Pushya constellation, नियतम् certainly, दैवचिन्तकाः astrologers, वक्ष्यन्ते say

40002390.author: Translation
40002390.content: Today the Moon is in conjunction with the Punarvasu constellation. Tomorrow the  Moon's conjunction with the Pushya constellation is certain and the astrologers say this auspicious time is highly suitable for the purpose of coronation.

40002391.author: पदार्थः
40002391.content: ﻿﻿ ततः therefore, पुष्ये in the Pushya constellation, अभिषिञ्चस्व be coronated , मनः my mind, माम् me, त्वरयतीव looks hastening up, परन्तप O slayer of enemies, अहम् I, श्वः tomorrow, त्वाम् you, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I shall install.

40002391.author: Translation
40002391.content: ﻿﻿ My mind is hastening me saying, 'Coronate Rama in the Pushya constellation itself'. O Slayer of enemies, I shall install you heir apparent tomorrow.

40002392.author: पदार्थः
40002392.content: तस्मात्  therefore, अद्यप्रभृति  from now, इयम् this, निशा night, नियतात्मना with selfrestraint, दर्भप्रस्तरशायिना sleeping on a bed of darbha or kusha grass, त्वया by you, वध्वा सह with daughterinlaw,  Sita, उपवस्तव्या should be spent by undertaking fasting.

40002392.author: Translation
40002392.content: Therefore, you and my daughterinlaw (Sita) should fast tonight and sleep on a bed of darbha or kusha grass with selfrestraint.

40002393.author: पदार्थः
40002393.content: अद्य today, सुहृदश्च your friends also, समन्ततः on all sides, अप्रमत्ताः vigilantly, त्वाम् you, रक्षन्तु protect, एवं विधानि of this sort, कार्याणि acts, बहुविघ्नानि many impediments, भवन्ति हि will happen, indeed.

40002393.author: Translation
40002393.content: Many impediments befall  acts of this sort indeed. Alert your friends to protect you  from all sides today onwards.

40002394.author: पदार्थः
40002394.content: भरतः Bharata, इतः पुरात् from this city, यावदेव while, विप्रोषितः away from, तावदेव till that time, ते to you, अभिषेकः consecration, प्राप्तकालः favourable time, मम(मे) my, मतः opinion.

40002394.author: Translation
40002394.content: While Bharata is away from the city, the time is favourable for your installation. This is my opinion.

40002395.author: पदार्थः
40002395.content: ते your, भ्राता brother, भरतः Bharata, कामम् really, सतां वृत्ते on the path of the virtuous, स्थितः stayed, ज्येष्ठानुवर्ती follows his elder brother, धर्मात्मा righteous, सानुक्रोशः compassionate, जितेन्द्रियः has controlled his senses.

40002395.author: Translation
40002395.content: It is true, your brother Bharata has adhered to the path of the virtuous and has followed his elder brother. No doubt, he is righteous, compassionate and self controlled.

40002396.author: पदार्थः
40002396.content: किन्तु yet, धर्मनित्यानाम् those fixed in righteousness, सतां च virtuous people also, मनुष्याणाम् men's, कृतशोभि made propitious, चित्तम् mind, अनित्यम् इति is fickle, मे my, मतिः my opinion.

40002396.author: Translation
40002396.content: Yet I think even the propitious minds of those who are virtuous and whose thoughts are fixed in righteousness can also become fickle.

40002397.author: पदार्थः
40002397.content: श्वः tomorrow, भाविनि that will take place, अभिषेचने about installation ceremony, इति thus, उक्तः spoken of, सः that, रामः Rama, व्रज इति 'you may go', अभ्यनुज्ञातः having been permitted, पितरम् father, अभिवाद्य having paid obeisance, गृहम् to his abode, अभ्ययात् returned.

40002397.author: Translation
40002397.content: Having spoken to Rama about the installation ceremony fixed for the next day, he (Dasaratha) permitted him to leave saying, 'You may go'. Rama paid obeisance to his father and returned to his abode.

40002398.author: पदार्थः
40002398.content: राज्ञा by the king, अभिषेचने with regard to installation, उद्दिष्टे when it was fixed, आत्मनः his own, वेश्म house, प्रविश्य entered in, तत्क्षणेन immediately, विनिर्गम्य having left, मातुः mother's, अन्तःपुरम् inner apartment, ययौ departed.

40002398.author: Translation
40002398.content: With the installation fixed by the king, Rama went into his residence but left immediately to see his mother in her inner apartment.

40002399.author: पदार्थः
40002399.content: तत्र there, देवतागारे in the room (meant for worship) of the gods, प्रवणामेव engrossed in devotion, क्षौमवासिनीम् wearing silk apparels, वाग्यताम् silently, श्रियम् for royal fortune,  आयाचतीम् praying, ताम् मातरम् that mother, ददर्श beheld.

40002399.author: Translation
40002399.content: There he beheld his mother in silk apparel engrossed in silent prayer (to the gods) for his royal fortune in the room meant for the worship of the gods.

40002400.author: पदार्थः
40002400.content: प्रियम् welcome tidings, रामाभिषेचनम् of installation of Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रागेव preceding him (Rama), तथा also, सुमित्रा Sumitra, आगता had arrived, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सीता च also Sita, आनायिता had been summoned.

40002400.author: Translation
40002400.content: Hearing the welcome tidings of the installation of her beloved Rama, Sita too, had been brought in. Sumitra and Lakshmana had already arrived there.

40002401.author: पदार्थः
40002401.content: तस्मिन् काले at that moment, कौशल्या Kausalya, सुमित्रया by Sumitra, सीतया by Sita, लक्ष्मणेन च by Lakshmana, अन्वास्यमाना being accompanied, आमीलितेक्षणा with halfclosed eyes, तस्थौ stood.

40002401.author: Translation
40002401.content: At that moment Kausalya was meditating with her eyes halfclosed. Sumitra, Lakshmana and Sita were attending on her.

40002402.author: पदार्थः
40002402.content: पुष्येण In Pushya constellation, पुत्रस्य son's, यौवराज्याभिषेचनम् installation as heirapparent, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्राणायामेन by controlling the breath, पुरुषम् supreme god, जनार्दनम् Lord Visnu, ध्यायमाना meditating upon.

40002402.author: Translation
40002402.content: Having heard that installation of her son as heirapparent was planned in Pushya constellation, Kausalya was meditating upon the Supreme Person, Lord Visnu by controlling her breath (Pranayama).

40002403.author: पदार्थः
40002403.content: सः रामः that Rama, तथा in that manner, सनियमामेव engaged in prayer, अभिगम्य having approached, अभिवाद्य च having made reverential salutation, ताम् her, हर्षयन् enhancing her joy, अनिन्दितां वचनम् words of praise, उवाच said.

40002403.author: Translation
40002403.content: While she (Kausalya) was in that state of meditation, Rama approached her, offered reverential salutation and said these words of praise enhancing her joy:
